assay.library_construction: Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA Library Kit (Swift) with EZ-96 DNA Methylation-Gold Mag Prep; lambda spike-in reported in GEO protocol
assay.directional_guidance: Accel-NGS Adaptase libraries are typically treated as non-directional for bisulfite dual-index alignment; set actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs.directional=false unless site validation says otherwise.

why_this_run: Public GEO/SRA WGBS produced for the methylGrapher paper on HPRC individuals.
HG00621 is represented in the first Human Pangenome draft graphs used by stock Giraffe and methylGrapher BS bundles.
Paired-end human WGBS suitable for linear fq2bam_meth, stock Giraffe (engineering comparator), and methylGrapher WGBS.
NVIDIA Parabricks does not publish a WGBS FASTQ fixture; this replaces that assumption with a citable public source.

license_use.note: Public SRA/GEO release under BioProject PRJNA1086543. Non-PHI. Retain accession and PubMed citation in canary reports.
license_use.citation: Wang et al., Nucleic Acids Research (methylGrapher); GEO GSE261315; SRA SRR28293403.

storage_layout.notes: Lives under the pangenome inventory tree (not lab fastqStorage) so provenance from the HPRC/methylGrapher project is obvious. Mirror with scripts/sync_genomes_to_s3.sh --only pangenome/canary.

subset_recipe.description: Deterministic paired-end subset: take the first N read pairs from the full FASTQ pair (same order, both mates). No random sampling at canary runtime.
subset_recipe.notes: Operators set subset_read_pairs in the site testing.sample_prep_canary block. Provisioning writes SHA-256 after materialization.

comparator_policy.pangenome: stock Giraffe engineering/robustness comparator only; do not require methylation parity with linear or methylGrapher
comparator_policy.pangenome_wgbs: bisulfite-aware methylGrapher path; compare QC/H5 metrics to linear using operator-set thresholds
